t: You're looking at the Head of Oscar Wilde, a sculpture by Eduardo Paolozzi. Paolozzi finished it in 1998, but it was not unveiled until 2024. Paolozzi was a Scottish artist, widely considered one of the pioneers of pop art. The head commemorates Oscar Wilde, the Irish writer who became one of the most popular and influential dramatists in London in the early 1890s. He is best known for The Picture of Dorian Gray, and for his epigrams and plays.
